note: Each quoted line, attributed to its human-correct speaker. The hard case: 'Dron' is male but the name carries no gender signal, so a mass-dominant binder can capture 'she said' onto the heavier, more-recent Dron. These labels are the ground truth a reader would give.

bindings.sentence: The peasants will not take the grain
They say they will not leave the village
My father left word that they be moved
They do not believe the French are coming
And you, Dron, what do you believe
I believe what the mistress tells me
Then tell them the grain is theirs
Tell them I give it freely
